Rooms.Name: The Temple of Yanaquri
Rooms.Description:
As you reach the end of the temple, a swirling darkness surrounds
you.  The warmth of the jungle fills your very soul as you find
yourself in the most holy of places.  The walls and ceiling once
again depict a night-time jungle, but this time the scene is much
more vivid. In the center of the hall stands an enormous statue.  You
may stay here in awe of this place, or you can continue back towards
the entrance of the temple to the south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The mural depicts the night-time jungle, but it appears almost too
life-like to be a painting.  As you reach to touch the mural, you can
almost feel the leaves on the trees.  You hear a low growl behind
you, and as you turn to look, you are stunned to see a fierce feline
beast flying through the trees in your direction.  Only when the
sharp claws of the beast do not tear the life from you do you realize
that it is only a part of the painting.

Rooms.Name: The Spiral of Life
Rooms.Description:
Ever-spiraling inward, life is a mystery to which few hold the
key.  As one reaches what appears to be the end of the spiral, she is
returned back along the same path once more.  While a mortal life may
end, the energy that drove that life never ceases to exist.  The
spiral continues ever-inward

Rooms.Name: The Temple of Yanaquri
Rooms.Description:
The long hall leads through the center of the magnificent temple. 
The mural in this part of the temple depicts a beautiful woman
dressed in black robes.  You can't seem to shake the feeling that you
are being followed as you wander through the temple.  The large hall
continues to the north and south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The woman depicted in the mural is dressed completely in black.  Her
hair is the color of night, and her eyes are the color of the jungle. 
She is bathed by the light of a pure moonbeam as she stands with her
arms outstretched.  A cloud of darkness surrounds her, and as you
inspect it more carefully, you can see the shapes of several
creatures in its smoky depths.

Rooms.Name: The Temple of Yanaquri
Rooms.Description:
The long hallway continues through the center of the temple.  The
walls and ceiling are painted with a magnificent mural depicting a
beautiful woman in green robes.  As you wander through the temple,
you become to feel a little unneasy, as if you are being followed. 
When you turn to look, you see nothing but the mural.  The hall
continues to the north and south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The mural depicts a beautiful woman dressed in green robes.  She
stands in the center of the jungle with her arms outstretched. 
Behind her is a swirling cloud of both darkness and light. The woman
smiles gently at you from the painting, and you feel as if you have
seen her before.

Rooms.Name: The Temple of Yanaquri
Rooms.Description:
An enormous hall leads through the center of the temple.  The
walls and ceiling have been painted with a beautiful mural depicting
a night-time jungle.  The floor is covered with a soft, spongy
material, that feels an awful lot like the jungle floor.  In this
place high above the trees, you feel as if you are on the ground
below, surrounded by the jungle and all of its inhabitants.  The hall
continues to the north, and the entrance of the temple is to the
south.

Exits.Description: An enormous door made of pure gold guards the entrance to the temple.
One of the panels appears to be somewhat loose.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The mural depicts the beauty of the jungle as it is at night.  As you
inspect the painting carfully, you notice that several glowing appear
to be gazing out at you from the trees.  Behind one tree, it appears
as if the wall panel is loose, and it might possibly be moved.

Rooms.Name: The Entrance to the Temple
Rooms.Description:
As you cross the rope bridge leading to the temple, the sounds of
the jungle suddenly cease. It is as if every creature is holding its
breath, waiting to see if you are going to make it inside.  The
entrance to the temple itself is quite magnificent.  Two large
jaguars, carved from the finest mahogany, stand guard on either side
of an enormous door made of pure gold.  You can either attempt to
enter the temple to the north, or return to the village to the south.

Exits.Description: An enormous door made of pure gold guards the entrance to the temple.
A rope bridge leads back to the village.

Rooms.Name: Mikuna'wasi
Rooms.Description:
The inhabitants of Miki'erke, while great hunters, sometimes want
to just relax and have their food prepared for them.  For this
purpose, Mikuna'wasi is the place to go.  A choice of raw and cooked
foods is offered by the finest chef in these parts, Mikuna himself!
The delicious smell of game permeates the air, making your mouth
water and your stomach growl.

Rooms.Name: A Small Hut
Rooms.Description:
The small hut appears to be some sort of sleeping area.  Mats line
the floors, many of which appear to still be occupied by sleepy
inhabitants.  A small fire burns warmly in the center of the room,
the smoke escaping through a small hole cut in the ceiling above.  An
open doorway leads to a small rope bridge to the south.

Rooms.Name: Miski'wasi
Rooms.Description:
Who ever said that all felines are carnivores?  They seem to enjoy
sweets just as much as anyone else, and Miski'wasi is the place to go
for delicious sugar-coated treats.  Prepared by Miski herself, the
yummy sweets here are quite exotic and very delicious.  Everything is
100% natural, with no added sugar or preservatives.  The jungle
provides the sweetness, and the treats never last long enough to need
preservatives!

Rooms.Name: On a Rope Bridge
Rooms.Description:
The wide rope bridge spans the space between the village and a
large temple.  To the south stands Miqi'erke, as it has for hundreds
of generations.  To the north stands an ominous temple.  Below you is
the expansive jungle, with all the life that it holds.

Rooms.Name: A Small Hut
Rooms.Description:
The small hut appears to be some sort of sleeping area.  Mats line
the floors, many of which appear to still be occupied by sleepy
inhabitants.  A small fire burns warmly in the center of the room,
the smoke escaping through a small hole cut in the ceiling above.  An
open doorway leads to a small rope bridge to the south.

Rooms.Name: The Smiling Para'miqi
Rooms.Description:
Laughter fills the air of this fun-filled place.  While the
Miqi'erke are serious about their duties, they are also serious about
enjoying themselves.  Several tables are scattered about the room,
many of which are covered with drinks and games.  A large bar spans
the western wall, and a wide variety of Miqi'erken brews are neatly
shelved behind it.  This is a place to relax and enjoy the good life.

Rooms.Name: A Small Hut
Rooms.Description:
The small hut appears to be some sort of sleeping area.  Mats line
the floors, many of which appear to still be occupied by sleepy
inhabitants.  A small fire burns warmly in the center of the room,
the smoke escaping through a small hole cut in the ceiling above.  An
open doorway leads to a small rope bridge to the south.

Rooms.Name: The Circle of Tuta
Rooms.Description:
A large circular platform made of mahogany floats above the
canopy.  The circle appears to be a place of worship.  Offerings of
flowers, fruit, nuts, and flesh have been left at various points at
the edge of the circle.  The circle continues to the south and east.

Rooms.Name: The Circle of Tuta
Rooms.Description:
A large circular platform made of mahogany floats above the
canopy.  The circle appears to be a place of worship.  Offerings of
flowers, fruit, nuts, and flesh have been left at various points at
the edge of the circle.  The circle continues to the east and west.

Rooms.Name: The Nursery
Rooms.Description:
This small hut is where the young of the village are raised.  Toys
are scattered all over the place, making it very difficult to
traverse the room.  A small rocking chair sits in the corner in front
of several small mats, apparently arranged so that they may be used
for story time or nap time.  In the center of the hut, a small fire
burns surrounded by a large iron rail to keep the kittens away from
the hot embers.  An open doorway leads east onto a rope bridge.

Rooms.Name: The End of the Skyway
Rooms.Description:
The skyway ends as it branches into three smaller bridges leading
to the north, south, and west.  Small buildings lie at the end of
each bridge.  Smoke rises from a small hole cut in the roof of the
structure to the north.  The buildings to the south and west appear
to be empty, but in this village you can never be quite sure.

Rooms.Name: The Skyway
Rooms.Description:
The skyway makes its way through the tree-top village on an
east-west route.  The wide planks seem to be quite sturdy, but it's
probably best to keep your eyes from straying to the view into the
canopy far below.  To the north and south, smaller bridges lead into
buildings.

Rooms.Name: The Skyway
Rooms.Description:
The wide bridge cuts through the jungle sky on its way through the
village.  Smaller bridges branch off to the north and south, leading
into buildings.  A delicious odor reaches your nose from the north. 
The skyway continues through the village to the east and west.

Rooms.Name: The Skyway
Rooms.Description:
The numerous tree-top walkways and bridges appear to all meet this
broad skyway.  An enormous bridge itself, the skyway is made of large
planks of wood taken from the jungle itself.  The skyway continues
through the village to the east and west, and smaller bridges branch
off to the north and south.

Rooms.Name: The Skyway
Rooms.Description:
The large skyway allows access to various structures in the
village.  To the north and south smaller bridges lead into tree-top
huts.  The skyway continues through the village to the east and west. 
Strange sounds can be heard coming from the east.

Rooms.Name: The Skyway
Rooms.Description:
As the skyway continues through the village, you notice that you
are not alone here.  From a rather large structure to the north, you
can hear the sounds of laughter.  To the south stands a smaller
building, with sounds of battle coming from within.  The skyway
continues to the east and west.

Rooms.Name: The Skyway
Rooms.Description:
The wide bridge cuts through the jungle sky on its way through the
village.  Smaller bridges branch off to the north and south, leading
into buildings.  To the east you can hear strange sounds, almost like
chanting, but in voices unlike any you have ever heard before.  The
skyway also continues through the village to the west.

Rooms.Name: The Darkness of Night
Rooms.Description:
The darkness of night surrounds you as you make your way across
the wide bridge.  Your light source can barely penetrate the black
void.  Strange sounds come from the east, an eerie chanting in an
unusual voice.  The glow of torchlight attempts to enter this dark
place from the west, but the darkness maintains its presence to the
east.

Rooms.Name: The Darkness of Night
Rooms.Description:
The blackness of the night surrounds you on your journey through
the sky.  A strange chanting emenates from the east.  The sounds of a
night jungle surround you and attempt to claw their way into your
very being.  You feel a presence on the bridge with you, but you
cannot see it through the darkness!  The darkened skyway continues
above the jungle to the east and west.

Rooms.Name: The Circle of Tuta
Rooms.Description:
A large circular platform made of mahogany floats above the
canopy.  The circle appears to be a place of worship.  Offerings of
flowers, fruit, nuts, and flesh have been left at various points at
the edge of the circle.  The circle continues to the north and south. 
A small rope bridge serves as an exit from the circle to the west.

Rooms.Name: The Center of the Circle
Rooms.Description:
At the center of the circular platform, a magnificent statue has
been erected.  A pure beam of moonlight shines down upon the statue,
and you realize that this circle is in a perpetual night.  Several
small offerings have been left in reverance of the statue.  The
circle surrounds this point on every side.

Rooms.Name: The Circle of Tuta
Rooms.Description:
A large circular platform made of mahogany floats above the
canopy.  The circle appears to be a place of worship.  Offerings of
flowers, fruit, nuts, and flesh have been left at various points at
the edge of the circle.  The circle continues to the north and south.

Rooms.Name: On a Rope Bridge
Rooms.Description:
The rope bridge crosses the space between several very large
trees.  You wonder just how this village stays in place, as there
doesn't seem to be anything supporting it.  The structures appear to
be sturdy, but they do not seem to be resting on anything solid.  The
rope bridge continues into the village to the north, and out of the
village to the south.

Rooms.Name: A Small Hut
Rooms.Description:
The small hut appears to be some sort of sleeping area.  Mats line
the floors, many of which appear to still be occupied by sleepy
inhabitants.  A small fire burns warmly in the center of the room,
the smoke escaping through a small hole cut in the ceiling above.  An
open doorway leads to a small rope bridge to the north.

Rooms.Name: The Training Grounds
Rooms.Description:
Stealth and cunning are the tools of the Miqi'erke, but they know
that strength and skill are also quite important.  Many brave
warriors have passed through these doors, and many more will follow. 
A large altar stands in the center of the room, indicating the
Miqi'erke allegiance to their great father.  They will fight to the
death for him if it is necessary, for they know that death is but one
step in the spiral of life.

Rooms.Name: A Small Hut
Rooms.Description:
The small hut appears to be some sort of sleeping area.  Mats line
the floors, many of which appear to still be occupied by sleepy
inhabitants.  A small fire burns warmly in the center of the room,
the smoke escaping through a small hole cut in the ceiling above.  An
open doorway leads to a small rope bridge to the north.

Rooms.Name: On a Rope Bridge
Rooms.Description:
As you make your way across the rope bridge, you happen to glance
down into the canopy.  You can barely see the ground below, and it
looks like it's miles away.  The bridge continues into the village to
the north, and the entrance of the village is to the south.

Rooms.Name: The Village of Miqi'erke
Rooms.Description:
A large village, built into the very jungle itself, fills the
canopy with its splendor.  Hidden from the ground below, this
civilization has remained a secret to all but a few for thousands of
generations.  Replacing the roads of a typical village is a vast
network of rope bridges.  The village itself has been built into the
trees, with magnificent structures made of the finest wood the jungle
has to offer.  A large rope bridge leads to the north, and a small
hut lies to the south.  A strange sound emenates from the northeast -
it resembles chanting, but the voices are like none you have ever
heard before.

Exits.Description: A large rope bridge leads into the village.
A small hut stands guard at the entrance of the village.

Mobs.Name: kitten grey para miqi para'miqi feline
Mobs.LongDescription: A grey ball of fur stalks a bowl of cream.
Mobs.Description:
The grey ball of fur shows off as he pounces onto a bowl of cream,
spilling it everywhere!  This little fellow will someday become a
Para'miqi, a mischievious race of felines that inhabit dwellings and
steal goodies from them.  His green eyes have a glimmer of mischief
in them already, so he is well on his way to fulfilling his destiny.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 purr;%5 emote pounces on your big toe!

Mobs.Name: kitten white rit'i feline
Mobs.LongDescription: A snow white kitten stretches out to take a nap.
Mobs.Description:
This kitten has a coat of the purest white.  He will someday become
one of the Rit'i, or snow cats, who live high in the mountains at the
edge of the jungle.  For now he just bides his time in the warmth of
the village, delighting in all the attention his lovely coat has
gotten him.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote grooms his beautiful coat.

Mobs.Name: kitten spotted ch'ekche feline
Mobs.LongDescription: A tiny spotted kitten is chasing the shadows out of the room.
Mobs.Description:
This little ball of fur is covered with a golden coat that has been
sprinkled with black spots.  The fierce hunter in him is only now
showing itself, but he is only strong enough to stalk the shadows, or
the occassional tail of a littermate.  Someday he will become a
Ch'ekche, the race of felines that inhabit the jungles of the east.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote stalks his littermates tail!

Mobs.Name: kitten black malki feline
Mobs.LongDescription: Hiding in the shadows, a small black kitten prepares to pounce!
Mobs.Description:
As black as night, this kitten will someday become a Malki.  His race
inhabits the jungles of the west, hiding in the trees until nightfall
when they are the most lethal of all jungle beasts.  He practices his
pouncing skills on his littermates for now, and he's gotten quite
good at attacking dustballs!
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote pounces on a dustball.;%5 lick nursemaid

Mobs.Name: kitten golden paqu feline
Mobs.LongDescription:
Like a ray of sunshine, the golden kitten lights up the room with his 
smile.
Mobs.Description:
While most of the felines of Miqi'erke prefer the night, this little
fellow is comfortable in the daylight.  His tiny paws hold the
beginnings of very powerful claws, and his little head is just
starting to show a majestic mane.  He will someday become a Paqu, the
race of felines that moved from the jungles into the open plains. 
There his kind is feared by all.  Here in the village, he just brings
a little bit of sunshine into the otherwise dark jungle.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 smile

Mobs.Name: kitten striped suwa feline
Mobs.LongDescription: As stealthy as a thief, the striped kitten steals a piece of meat.
Mobs.Description:
He stalks the nursery much like his race of Suwa stalk the jungle. 
His kind is the striped hunter with powerful claws and an attitude to
match.  For now he is just a nuisance to his littermates, always
stealing their food until the nursemaid catches him in the act.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 blink;%5 emote steals a piece of meat from his littermate.

Mobs.Name: nursemaid malki feline
Mobs.LongDescription: Smiling gently, the feline nursemaid watches after the kittens.
Mobs.Description:
The feline nursemaid has been charged by Yanaquri with the duty of
caring for all the kittens.  She takes her job very seriously, and
she will protect them fiercely as if they were her own.  Like most of
the villagers, she is unable to bear her own, relying on the grace of
Yanaquri to populate Miqi'erke.  The nursemaid wears a coat of the
purest black fur, indicating that she is of the Malki race.  Her
emerald green eyes are fierce at first glance, but as you gaze into
them you relize her true nature.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote smiles pleasantly.

Mobs.Name: oqe grey feline
Mobs.LongDescription: Smiling innocently, the grey feline looks like mischief itself.
Mobs.Description:
Oqe is the ever-smiling feline that is always playing tricks on the
villagers.  He is a patriarch of the Para'miqi, whose stories are
told by many races.  Oqe is one of the Juq'wawa, or first generation,
of Miqi'erke.  It was his litter that originally founded all of the
wild feline races.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 grin;%5 stare;%5 emote tries to look innocent.

Mobs.Name: yuraq white feline
Mobs.LongDescription: Yuraq stands before you, grooming her beautiful white coat.
Mobs.Description:
Yuraq wears a coat of the purest white.  Her emerald green eyes are
the only bits of color that adorn her body.  She is a matriarch of
the Rit'i, or the mountain felines.  She has returned to Miqi'erke to
assist with the initiation of the newest litter into the secret order
of Yanaquri.  She will soon return to her mountain home with a new
generation of Rit'i.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 purr;%5 stretch

Mobs.Name: mikhu black feline
Mobs.LongDescription: As black as the jungle night, the black feline wears an aura of power.
Mobs.Description:
The bringer of night, Mikhu is one of the companions of Tuta.  She is
the mother of a powerful race of jungle felines, known as the Malki. 
A direct descendant of Tuta herself, Mikhu is one of the Juq'wawa, or
first generation of Miqi'erke.  Her offspring have inhabited this
very jungle and protected it for thousands of generations.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote looks deep into your eyes.

Mobs.Name: phuyu spotted feline
Mobs.LongDescription: With a flick of his tail, the spotted feline lands silently.
Mobs.Description:
The mighty Phuyu is the patriarch of the Ch'ekche race.  His kind
have lived in the trees for many generations, always ready to pounce
down onto unsuspecting prey.  He has a golden coat, covered with
black spots, and emerald green eyes.  As with the other adults of
this village, he is able to walk upright in the manner of Yanaquri. 
He can change his shape at will however, and with the blink of an eye
he may just disappear into the jungle.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote disappears suddenly!;%5 hide

Mobs.Name: rey golden feline
Mobs.LongDescription: A majestic beast stands before you, wearing his golden mane proudly.
Mobs.Description:
King of the beasts in his own domain, Rey is a majestic creature
worthy of his title.  He is the son of Yanaquri and P'unqay, the
goddess of the day.  He is patriarch of the Paqu, the felines that
live in the golden sunlight.  His golden mane is quite majestic
indeed, and his powerful claws seem to serve as a reminder of his
authority.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote unleashes a tremendous roar!

Mobs.Name: tigri striped feline
Mobs.LongDescription: The feline thief grins mischieviously.
Mobs.Description:
The stealthy thief of the jungle, Tigri smiles quietly knowing he
could steal your very soul if he so desired.  His beatuful striped
coat allows him to hide quietly in the forest, waiting for his next
victim to come along.  Tigri is the patriarch of the Suwa felines,
who inhabit the jungles of the east.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote moves quickly, and you notice your underwear is gone!;%5
blink

Mobs.Name: infant wawa feline
Mobs.LongDescription: An infant crawls along the floor, meowing pitifully.
Mobs.Description:
The infant wears only what she came into the world with.  She has
tawny fur and bright green eyes.  Her tiny paws hold the beginnings
of claws that will someday make her quite the huntress.  She is Wawa,
the infant, and she represents the beginnings of the Miqi'erke.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 cry

Mobs.Name: child erk'e feline
Mobs.LongDescription: A Miqi'erke child purrs contentedly as she plays.
Mobs.Description:
The young child has only recently grown large enough to adventure on
her own, but she knows she must return to the safety of her family
before too long.  Her tawny fur is starting to show dark brown
stripes, which will someday allow her to blend perfectly with the
foliage of her jungle home.  She is Erk'e, the child, and she
represents the youth of Miqi'erke.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 smile

Mobs.Name: adolescent sipas feline
Mobs.LongDescription: An adolescent purrs quietly as she grooms her beautiful coat.
Mobs.Description:
With her tawny coat and dark brown stripes, this adolescent may blend
perfectly with the foliage of her jungle home.  Her green eyes
sparkle with the light of youth, but she is learning quickly and will
soon be an adult.  She is Sipas, the adolescent, and she represents
the time of life between youth and adulthood.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 purr

Mobs.Name: woman adult warmi feline
Mobs.LongDescription: Almost hidden in the shadows, an adult watches you intently.
Mobs.Description:
A tawny coat and dark brown stripes allow this adult Miqi'erke to
blend perfectly with her shadowy surroundings.  She is a child of
night, preferring the cool darkness of the jungle to the opressive
heat of day.  Her long sharp claws are ready for attack, just in case
she needs them. She is Warmi, the woman, and she represents
adulthood.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote watches your every move.

Mobs.Name: paya old woman feline
Mobs.LongDescription: Deceptively quiet, an ancient feline stands watch over her domain.
Mobs.Description:
The wisdom of the ages seems to reside with this ancient feline.  She
is strong and lean, at the peak of her power, but she knows that
death lies around the next corner.  She is Paya, the old woman, and
she represents the elders and wise ones.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote smiles knowingly.;%5 emote quietly grooms her coat.

Mobs.Name: qoyllor star feline
Mobs.LongDescription: Shinging brightly, Qoyllor is ready to ascend to Tuta.
Mobs.Description:
As the Miqi'erke grow weary of the life of a mortal, they are allowed
to ascend into the night sky to live with Tuta.  There they live for
an eternity, returning to the jungle only at night in the guise of
Qoyllor.  Some choose to return eventually as Wawa, starting with a
new mortal life.

Mobs.Name: tuta night sky dark goddess statue feline
Mobs.Description:
Tuta, the night, rules over the realm of darkness in the jungle.  Her
statue depicts a woman dressed in black, with hair the color of night
and eyes the color of the jungle.  Her outstreched arms seem to be
reaching to embrace her children, the inhabitants of the dark jungle.

Mobs.Name: feline god yanaquri statue
Mobs.Description:
The fierce protector of the jungle, Yanaquri is the patron of the
Miqi'erke.  He is quite feline, wearing a coat the color of night,
and a mane of pure gold.  His long tail is covered with a roseated
pattern, and his sharp claws are held within paws of the darkest
black.  His fierce green eyes shine with the light of the moon, and
he wears a gentle smile that shows off his sharp teeth.  While he
wears a fierce facade, Yanaquri is known by his disciples to be a
kind and just god.

Mobs.Name: mikuna chef cook feline
Mobs.LongDescription: A large, and rather heavy feline stands stirring over a large pot.
Mobs.Description:
Mikuna is a jovial fellow, always smiling as he prepares his
culinary delights for Miqi'erke.  He smells of his own delicious
concoctions, bits of which are stuck in the thick fur around his
mouth.  He smiles gently as he offers a whiff of his latest culinary
masterpiece.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote pats his ample belly.;%5 emote tastes a bit of stew from
 his pot.;%5 'How would you like to sample some of my tasty treats?

Mobs.Name: miski sweets feline
Mobs.LongDescription: Stuffing her ample mouth with sweets, Miski smiles happily.
Mobs.Description:
Miski seems to taste more of her delicious treats than she sells!
She is very large, and very round.  Her gray coat has bits of fruit
stuck to it, and her hands are covered with sugar.  She smiles
innocently as she pulls a bit of candy from the fur on her chest.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 smile;%5 emote eats a candied fairy wing.;%5 blush;%5 'Hello
 sweetie!  How would you like to try one of my delicious bug bars?

Mobs.Name: feline bibu bartender
Mobs.LongDescription: Bibu shtaggersh ofer and offersh you a pint *hic* of hish finesht.
Mobs.Description:
Bibu loves his drink, and he drinks as much of it as he possibly can.
He is a Para'miqi, son of Oqe, which is easy to tell by his soft grey
coat.  This mischievious fellow smells very strongly of ale and stale
smoke, but he doesn't seem to mind as he leans in closely to offer
you a pint of hish finesht.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 hic;%5 emote staggers over to the bar.;%5 giggle;%5 'Shay buddy!
 Howshabout a tashte of shome catnip juish?

Mobs.Name: feline villager miqi'erken
Mobs.LongDescription: A villager heads towards the temple to worship his god.
Mobs.Description:
The Miqi'erken villager is almost invisible as he uses the shadows to
cover his movement.  He has a beautiful black coat and emerald green
eyes, and his powerful muscles ripple with every movement.

Mobs.Name: feline worshipper miqi'erken
Mobs.LongDescription: Bowing low before her god's likeness, the Miqi'erken chants softly.
Mobs.Description:
With her golden coat arranged around her, the Miqi'erken bows low
before the statue of her god, thanking him for his protection.  She
chants softly in a language made of words and sounds of the jungle.

Mobs.Name: villager feline miqi'erken
Mobs.LongDescription: A Miqi'erken wanders quietly through his village.
Mobs.Description:
The villager nods his noble head at your approach, signifying that he
means you no ill will, and hoping that you feel the same way.  His
golden mane rests majestically around his shoulders, signifying that
he is a Paqu, descended from Rey.

Mobs.Name: priestess tuta feline
Mobs.LongDescription: Black as night, the priestess tends to her duties and to Tuta.
Mobs.Description:
Chosen for her likeness to her ancestor Mikhu, the priestess guides
the villagers in their worship of Tuta.  She is tall and strong, with
a coat the color of night and eyes the color of the jungle.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 worsh goddess;%5 emote puts some flowers before the statue of Tuta.

Mobs.Name: priest yanaquri feline
Mobs.LongDescription: Bowing his head in reverance, the priest tends to his duties.
Mobs.Description:
To serve Yanaquri as a priest is a great honor for a Miqi'erke.  This
young feline knows the responsibility well, and he performs his
duties to the best of his ability.  He is tall and strong, with a
coat of pure gold.  His large eyes have a yellowish tint, and appear
to be very wise despite the priest's youthful appearance.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 worsh yanaquri;%5 emote bows his head.

Objects.Name: ball yarn feline
Objects.Description: A ball of bright yellow yarn sits here, waiting to be played with.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The ball of yarn has been well-used by the young Miqi'erke.  It's
tattered, but still holds its bright yellow color well.  It might
make a nice gift for your favorite young kitten.

Objects.Name: catnip essence bottle feline
Objects.Description: A bottle filled with a murky green liquid calls to you, 'Drink Me!'

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The small bottle is filled to the top with a murky green liquid.  It
doesn't look very appetizing, but the label on the bottle is covered
with pretty flowers and playful kittens.  It couldn't be that bad,
could it?

Objects.Name: catnip piece leaf feline
Objects.Description: A small leaf rests gently on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The small leaf is one of those few weaknesses that the Miqi'erke
have.  Catnip sells like crazy in the village of Miqi'erke, and
just one whiff of it could tell you why.  The odor of the catnip is
strangely invigorating, almost mind altering!

Objects.Name: catnip charm necklace silver feline
Objects.Description: A small charm fashioned from silver jingles as the wind blows.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The small charm is filled with pungent catnip, its scent oozing out
from every one of the hundreds of holes in the silvery surface.  A
small chain of silver makes its way through a tiny loop at the top,
allowing you to wear it around your neck.

Objects.Name: sandwich mouse feline
Objects.Description: A tasty sandwich tempts you.  Hmm...is that a tail sticking out?

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This tasty sandwich is made with all-natural products.  The crusty
bread is covered with tiny seeds.  Fresh catnip leaves add to the
delicious aroma.  As you look more closely, you notice tiny feet and
tails sticking out!  You lift the bread, and realize that this
delicious treat is made of mice, which have been sauteed in an
enticing mix of butter and vegetables.

Objects.Name: bird stew head bowl
Objects.ShortDescription: a bowl of bird head stew
Objects.Description: A steaming bowl of stew beckons you to taste it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Oh boy does this bowl of stew smell good!  Bits of jungle-grown
vegetables float in the thick broth, peeking out from between tiny
bird heads?!  That's right, bird heads!  What else would a feline
eat?

Objects.Name: frog legs roasted
Objects.Description: A pair of roasted frog legs look so fresh they might hop away!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This delicious treat was once the means of locomotion for one of the
many frog species in the jungle.  The chef has done them justice, and
they smell great (even if they look a bit strange).

Objects.Name: candy candied fairy wings wing
Objects.Description: A pair of candied fairy wings look like they could almost fly away.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These fairy wings have been coated with a special mixture of
natural sugar and secret spices.  The result is absolutely
magnificent, and quite tempting to the palate.

Objects.Name: rat tail chocolate covered
Objects.Description: Dripping with fresh chocolate, this tasty treat calls to you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Rat tails are an excellent source of protein, but not all that tasty.
However, dipped in chcolate, they are absolutely divine!

Objects.Name: bug bar candy candybar
Objects.Description: A small candybar sticks to the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This candybar looks good enough to eat!  That is, if you don't mind
a few bugs with your sweet tooth fix.  Filled with bugs of all shapes
and sizes, drenched in chocolate, and covered with a light dusting of
powdered catnip, this bar is quite a treat.

Objects.Name: pint catnip juice glass
Objects.Description: A pint glass of catnip juice looks quite tempting.  Drink up!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The frosted glass contains the amrbosia of all felines, catnip juice!
It's good for the mind, or so they say, and it doesn't taste half
bad.

Objects.Name: cup guava juice
Objects.Description: A large cup of guava juice wishes to tame your thirst.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This delicious liquid smells quite good.  As you inhale the delicious
odor of the sweet nectar, y notice a strong alcohol smell.  It looks
as if this juice is spiked!  Oh well, drink up!

Objects.Name: bladder water
Objects.Description: Full of delicious water, a leather bladder rests on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The bladder holds a considerable amount of water, which is just great
for any trip into the jungle.

Objects.Name: shadow oqe feline
Objects.Description: Is that your shadow at your feet, or is it something more?

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you move, so too does the shadow.  It follows you wherever you go,
and disappears only when it wants to.  It can keep you company as you
journey through life, never caring if you are a decent person.  It
may shroud you in the dark of night, when only the moonlight may mark
your presence, and it can shroud your misdeeds and pranks from
watching eyes.

Objects.Name: golden locket yuraq feline
Objects.Description: As bright as the golden sun, a small locket shines vibrantly.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This golden locket once belonged to Rey, the golden king of his
domain.  It's etched with a lovely likeness of his royal highness,
complete with mane and proud tail.  He was once in love with the fair
Yuraq, and gave her this locket as a token of his affection.

Objects.Name: night dark spot feline mikhu
Objects.Description: All light is banished from this dark spot on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As the light passes by this dark patch, it is quickly dispersed.  The
dark of night is the domain of Mikhu.  She stands by the side of
Tuta, enveloped in the darkness.

These small boots were crafted by Yanaquri himself.  They are made of
the finest leather, and are perfect for sneaking through the jungle,
much to the dismay of any prey that their owner may come upon.

Objects.Name: claws rey power feline
Objects.Description: A pair of sharp golden claws rest mightily on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These mighty claws are crafted from the finest metals to be found in
the jungle.  They were forged by the heat of the mighty Qoyllor, who
live in the night sky with Tuta.  A layer of gold covers the claws,
making them shine brightly.

Objects.Name: leggings striped tigri tiger feline tiger-striped
Objects.Description: Some poor tiger seems to have lost his stripes!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These lovely stripes appear to actually be a handsome pair of
leggings.  Worn by the powerful Tigri, they are what one source of
his strength and cunning.

Objects.Name: stuffed mouse toy feline erk'e
Objects.Description: Eeek!  It's a mouse!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The tiny mouse is stuffed with pungent catnip.  It looks quite real,
and it just might be, but now it's used as a toy for young
Miqi'erke children.

Objects.Name: staff paya feline
Objects.Description: Made from the finest mahogany, this staff is sturdy and strong.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The staff holds the wisdom of the jungle, and the key to discovering
it.  Made of the finest mahogany, it has endured through the ages as
a symbol of Paya.

Objects.Name: aura golden bright qoyllor feline
Objects.Description: An intensely bright aura seeks ascension to Tuta.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Shining as brightly as the stars in the sky, this aura is worn by the
Qoyllor as they ascend to Tuta.  It allows them to see their way into
her domain, and burns as a reminder to the mortal Miqi'erke of their
presence with her.

Objects.Name: dagger da'miqi yanaquri feline
Objects.Description: A powerful dagger puts fear in your heart, just from its presence.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This poweful dagger was a gift to Yanaquri from his mother.  It was
forged from the darkness of night, and tempered with the heat of the
Qoyllor.  In the capable hands of Yanaquri, it is the most poweful
weapon in existance!

Objects.Name: ring moonstone feline tuta
Objects.Description: Shining with the light of the moon, a small ring winks at you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large moonstone rests atop a band of the finest silver.  As you
gaze into the moonstone, you see the many faces of the night time
jungle staring back at you.
